LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_NoColonists: No colonists found on the current map.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_CompactViewTip: One slim row per colonist instead of the full cards. Details that no longer fit move into the tooltips.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_AutoAssignBtnTip: Open the live auto-assign preview: tune sourcing, anti-mech, ranged/melee and squad diversity with sliders and watch the resulting distribution before applying it.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_MassReplaceAmmoBtnTip: Swap the ammo type across all loadouts at once (e.g. everyone from FMJ to AP).
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_ArmCancelledNote: Auto-assign was cancelled - roles, packs and ammo bills from the earlier steps were kept, but no assignment was applied and no weapons were produced.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_EditRoleTip: Opens the Roles tab with this colonist's role selected, so you can edit the role itself.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_SaveRoleTipHas: Open Role Mode with this pawn's exact current combo (main weapon, sidearm/explosives/shields, packs) pre-filled as a draft - review and press Create there.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_SaveRoleTipNone: No loadout assigned yet - nothing to save.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_ProduceSkippedNote: Assignment applied. Production was skipped at that step - queue it later from Supply Loadouts if you still need it.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_ClickToViewEditGear: Click to view and edit the carried gear.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_ScoreCalcTooltip: Score Calculation: Calculated using Skill Level x 10, modified by Sight, Manipulation, Moving, and Traits. Bar Colors: Empty = 0 Deep Red = Bad Bright Green = Master (Max Level: {0})
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_CannotFightTip: Cannot fight (incapable of violence, or a baby), so no weapon can be assigned. An Equipment Pack or a Role without a weapon is still fine.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_CannotFightClearSuffi: The current one can still be cleared.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_DragToSwapSuffix: Drag onto another colonist's loadout button to swap.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_MassTip: Mass Total weight of everything in the loadout (weapons, ammo, meals, medicine) vs. how much {0} can carry. Carry capacity comes from the pawn's Carry Weight stat (CE), which scales with body size and Manipulation, so a big healthy colonist carries more than a small or injured one. This is CE's own limit, not RimWorld's larger Carrying Capacity - going over is what actually slows the pawn down.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_BulkTip: Bulk How much space the loadout takes up vs. this pawn's Carry Bulk stat (CE). Bulk is about volume, not weight - lots of loose ammo or armor eats bulk fast. Exceeding it hurts movement and aim.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_OverCapacityTip: This does not fit. The colonist will never pick up the excess - Combat Extended only takes what fits and drops anything over the limit, so the loadout stays partly unfulfilled. Reduce the ammo amount, drop a pack item, or pick lighter gear.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_MassTipCompact: Mass Loadout weight vs. this pawn's Carry Weight (CE). Going over slows the pawn down.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_BulkTipCompact: Bulk Loadout volume vs. this pawn's Carry Bulk (CE). Exceeding it hurts movement and aim.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_CannotFightMsg: {0} cannot fight (incapable of violence, or a baby), so only gear without a weapon can be assigned.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_PasteRoleRejectMsg: {0} is on a Role - packs, sidearms and other items come from the Role itself (Roles tab). Nothing was pasted.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_UnassignAllBtnTip: Every free colonist loses their loadout assignment - attached packs and sidearms stay.
LanguageData.CER_AssignLoadouts_UnassignAllConfirm: Remove the loadout assignment from every free colonist? Attached packs and sidearms stay; carried gear is not dropped.
